name: Google Search Console
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-13

# Summary
Google Search Console (GSC) is the source of truth for clicks, impressions, queries and indexing on every TAG site. Kim uses it through her signed-in Chrome ("Kim-Main"); Claude drives URL inspection there for indexing requests.

# Properties
- Pipeliners: domain property `sc-domain:pipelinersusa.com` (the only source that counts GBP link clicks) plus URL-prefix `https://pipelinersusa.com/`.
- Alphalete: URL-prefix `https://alphaletetrenchless.com/`.
- Summit AZ: `https://www.summitplumbingpros.com/`.
- Prestige: `sc-domain:prestigeplumbingsc.com` (sitemap first submitted Jul 4, 2026; 23 pages discovered).

# Indexing workflow ("continue the GSC indexing task")
1. Read the [GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker).
2. HTTP pre-check each queued URL and skip 301s.
3. URL-inspect in Kim-Main Chrome; skip anything already on Google, otherwise Request Indexing.
4. Stop at the first "Quota Exceeded" per property (about 13 manual requests per day per property; Alphalete guidance is about 6 to 18). After a block, wait 2 to 3 days on new or strict properties (Prestige, Pipeliners).
5. Update the tracker and report full URLs.
Note: GSC "not indexed" buckets lag, so always verify before requesting.

# Data rules
- Use the GSC UI, not the Search Atlas mirror, for page-level numbers ([Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) data is directional and drops anonymized queries).
- Filter US-only to exclude TAG's Philippines testing traffic.
- Screenshots of GSC numbers go into [Documentation Screenshots](lib:brain-documentation-screenshots).

# Open items noted
- Pipeliners crawled-not-indexed validation failed; the feeds/categories noindex fix needs re-validation after the remaining recrawl.
